subject: Neobank MAP: Security gate ownership + SOC2 evidence tracker
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Helen Park <helen.park@neobank.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up + MAP draft: security gate & SOC2 evidence (next steps)

Hi Helen — thanks again for the call today. Really appreciated the clarity on Neobank's production timeline and the security bar you outlined. Per our discussion, I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused around the milestones we flagged. I pulled out the security gate as a discrete milestone because it sits on your critical path to pilot.

Highlights / asks from our side: 
- Milestone: Security review complete / SOC2 package delivered — target: 2026-08-01 (placeholder)
- Immediate deliverable we need from you: completed SOC2 questionnaire (attached template "Neobank_SOC2_Questions.xlsx") and confirmation of any on-prem key management requirements.
- Redwood owners for the milestone: Ben Carter (commercial lead) + Priyom Das (security solutions).
- Suggested dependencies: procurement sign-off (PO or SOW), VPC peering window (if using Private), and mutual testing window for prefix caching.

I've also included a lightweight action grid in the MAP (tab "Security Gate") — please review and then tell me which dates look realistic from your side. If Procurement should be the owner for any of the dependencies, happy to loop them in.

Attachments: Neobank_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx; Redwood_SOC2_Packet_Summary.pdf; Neobank_SOC2_Questions.xlsx

Next steps: 
1) You review the MAP security tab and SOC2 questionnaire — reply with owners/dates by EOD Tue 7/13 if possible.
2) If Procurement needs to be engaged now, please share a contact and I'll set a short handoff call with our contracts team.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0142

From: Helen Park <helen.park@neobank.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neobank Procurement <procurement@neobank.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up + MAP draft: security gate & SOC2 evidence (next steps)

Ben — thanks for sending this over and for the clear framing. The MAP layout helps. A couple quick notes from my side after skimming the attachments: 

- The SOC2 questionnaire is the right starting point. I'll route it to our security operations team but I need to coordinate dates with Procurement and our Legal reviewer.
- Target date of 2026-08-01 looks aggressive given our internal change control — can we make the security gate target 2026-08-15 instead? That gives us two weeks to collect artifacts and run the internal checklist.
- We also have a short KMS/keys policy review that Priyom and your security engineer may need to attend. Can you confirm if Redwood can provide a one-page KMS integration summary?

Procurement (cc'd) — can you confirm whether we can do a Fast Track SOW (signature + 30 days) or if standard PO timelines apply? That will influence when we commit to the pilot start.

I'll review the MAP in more detail and provide owners/dates by Tue EOD.

—Helen
Helen Park
Head of Product Security
Neobank
helen.park@neobank.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Helen Park <helen.park@neobank.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up + MAP draft: security gate & SOC2 evidence (next steps)

Thanks Helen — 8/15 is totally reasonable. I've updated the MAP security tab (attached) and captured the revised milestone dates and owners. Quick reference excerpt from the MAP for the security gate: 

Security Gate (milestone) — target 2026-08-15
- Owner (Neobank): Head of Product Security (Helen Park) — deliver SOC2 questionnaire, map of in-scope systems.
- Owner (Redwood): Priyom Das — provide SOC2 packet, KMS integration summary, and evidence list.
- Dependencies: Procurement sign-off (Neobank procurement), VPC peering configuration (network engineering), and test dataset approval.
- Artifacts Redwood will share: Redwood_SOC2_Packet_Summary.pdf, sample IDS/alerting screenshots, KMS-integration-one-pager (stub).

Action items I committed to in the MAP: 
1) Priyom: share KMS integration summary + list of available SOC2 artifacts by 7/14.
2) Ben: schedule a 30-min KMS walkthrough for Helen + Neobank security ops (propose Thu 7/15 10:00 PT).
3) Neobank: return completed SOC2 questionnaire and procurement lead by 7/20.

I've attached a revised MAP: Neobank_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx (tab "Security Gate" updated). If Procurement needs an internal SOW template, I can loop in our contracts team — just say the word.

I'll book the KMS walkthrough pending your confirmation of attendees/time.

Best,
Ben

Attachments: Neobank_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx (updated), Redwood_SOC2_Packet_Summary.pdf

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Helen Park <helen.park@neobank.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up + MAP draft: security gate & SOC2 evidence (next steps)

Hi all — looping in a quick update from the security side. Per Ben's ask: 

- I'll deliver a one-page KMS integration summary and an evidence index by tomorrow EOD (7/14). The index will list artifacts we can provide immediately (SOC2 control mappings, retention configs, audit log samples, RBAC screenshots) and those that require additional operational steps (e.g., export of long-term log archives).
- For the SOC2 questionnaire: we can pre-fill sections that describe our control family coverage and attach the summary packet (Redwood_SOC2_Packet_Summary.pdf). For anything Neobank needs in a specific format, we can collaborate on the questionnaire during the KMS walkthrough.
- I can join the walkthrough on Thu 7/15 10:00 PT — that works for me.

Ben — I'll drop the two files to the Drive link you shared and include a short README so your procurement/legal can surface anything they need.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Security Solutions Lead
Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai
